principles: No central coordinator as a single point of failure
open_questions: How can Android/Windows adapters reconcile uncertain external side effects?
Which operations can guarantee idempotency at the destination?
Can lightweight gateway enforcement work across heterogeneous Wise APIs?
What measurable conditions justify multiple local cells?
How are grants revoked during network partitions?

timeline.title: Adapter gateway and uncertain effects proposed
timeline.detail: Owen identified that node epochs alone cannot fence operations. Proposed destination-side command validation, durable deduplication, and explicit reconciliation for nontransactional APIs. Under independent review; no implementation.

timeline.title: Partition-safe recovery policy proposed
timeline.detail: Separate service discovery from authorization. During network partitions, permit local observation but require fresh authorization before state-changing replay. Owen review requested; no implementation.

timeline.title: Owen review received; staged architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Owen recommends hybrid local cells and a durable relay. Workshop proposes starting with a simpler simulated broker test, then testing partition-tolerant cells. Both remain proposals; no implementation verified.

timeline.title: Public architecture observatory
timeline.detail: Shareable website and versioned public architecture feed initiated.

timeline.title: Hybrid architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Lightweight discovery registry, node agents, event transport, bounded self-repair.
